dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So, Chris, what does your company do?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈkrɪs, ˈwʌt dʌz jʊr ˈkʌmpəni ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's sort of a tech company. We make apps for hotels, restaurants and so on.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈsɔːrt əv ə ˈtɛk ˈkʌmpəni. wiː ˈmeɪk ˈæps fər hoʊˈtɛlz, ˈrɛstərɑːnts ənd ˈsoʊ ˌɑːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Apps for hotels? What kind of apps?
dialogue.reading: ˈæps fər hoʊˈtɛlz? ˈwʌt ˈkaɪnd əv ˈæps?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Booking apps, menu apps, that kind of thing. Pretty much every hotel needs one now.
dialogue.reading: ˈbʊkɪŋ ˈæps, ˈmɛnjuː ˈæps, ðæt ˈkaɪnd əv ˈθɪŋ. ˈprɪti ˈmʌtʃ ˈɛvri hoʊˈtɛl ˈniːdz ˈwʌn ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. How many people work there?
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ˈwɜːrk ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Fifty or so. Maybe sixty now. We're growing pretty fast.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɪfti ɔːr ˈsoʊ. ˈmeɪbi ˈsɪksti ˈnaʊ. wɪr ˈɡroʊɪŋ ˈprɪti ˈfæst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And what do you do there?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt duː juː ˈduː ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm a manager, sort of. I look after the designers, plan projects and so on.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ə ˈmænɪdʒər, ˈsɔːrt ʌv. aɪ ˈlʊk ˈæftər ðə dɪˈzaɪnərz, ˈplæn ˈprɑːdʒɛkts ənd ˈsoʊ ˌɑːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That sounds busy. Do you work long hours?
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈbɪzi. duː juː ˈwɜːrk ˈlɔːŋ ˈaʊərz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Pretty much every day. I usually leave at seven or so. But I like it.
dialogue.reading: ˈprɪti ˈmʌtʃ ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ. aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈliːv ət ˈsɛvən ɔːr ˈsoʊ. bʌt aɪ ˈlaɪk ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My school is very different. I finish at four every day!
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈskuːl ɪz ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt. aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ ət ˈfɔːr ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Lucky you! Maybe I should become a teacher or something.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʌki juː! ˈmeɪbi aɪ ʃʊd bɪˈkʌm ə ˈtiːtʃər ɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ.
